summary: Full backend + frontend E2E testing of 'Receitas Naturais para Pets'. Backend: 30 pytest tests created and all passed (stats 36/32/4, recipes list + pet/dificuldade/refeicao/busca filters, detail of ALL 36 recipes with complete fields + avisos, 404 for unknown id, warnings, 3 premium products, simulated cookie login/me/logout, 400 on empty/whitespace fields, 422 on missing field, name derivation from email). Frontend: login (incl. empty-form validation), personalized greeting 'Olá, Mariana!', stats cards, all 3 filter groups + search + empty state, recipe detail modal with all 7 sections (Benefícios/Ingredientes/Preparo/Indicado/Dicas/Regras de Ouro/Alimentos Proibidos), favorites (header counter, favorites-only view, cookie persistence after reload), Premium Products (3 cards, Saiba mais modal, 'Quero este produto' -> 'Em breve' modal), logout returning to login and staying logged out after reload. Mobile 390px layout verified.

ui_bugs.issue: The favorite heart button (top-4 right-4, 40x40) is rendered exactly on top of the Radix DialogContent close 'X' button (same coords x=1287,y=60; 1600px2 full overlap). Both remain functional in tests, but the X icon is drawn over the heart and is visually unreadable/ambiguous for users — high chance of accidental favoriting instead of closing. Move the heart to right-16 (or left side).

integration_issues.flow: Favoritas view vs active pet filter
integration_issues.issue: Favorites-only view filters the CURRENT server-filtered list (visible = recipes.filter(favorites)), so favorites of another pet are hidden. Reproduced: favorited 1 dog recipe (header count = 2), switched pet filter to 'Gatos' and enabled 'Favoritas' -> only 1 result shown while header shows 2. Inconsistent for users. Suggest fetching favorites by ids (pet=todos) or auto-resetting filters when favorites-only is active.

issues: Console error on every dialog open: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle for accessibility' + 'Missing Description or aria-describedby' for modal-recipe-detail and premium-detail-modal (a11y warning, no functional impact)
Stats cards (stat-total/stat-cats) render '0' for ~1s before /api/stats resolves; a skeleton/loading state would avoid the flash of wrong data
No visible loading spinner/state for /premium-products; section simply appears

action_items: RecipeModal: reposition modal-favorite-btn so it no longer overlaps the Radix close X button
Dashboard: make 'Favoritas' view show all favorited recipes regardless of the active pet/dificuldade/refeicao filters (or reset filters), so results-count matches favorites-count
Add DialogTitle (VisuallyHidden if needed) + aria-describedby to modal-recipe-detail and premium-detail-modal to clear a11y console errors
Optional: show skeleton for stats cards while /api/stats loads
critical_code_review_comments: server.py session cookie stores the raw username as its value with no signing — acceptable for the simulated-login MVP, but any value in pet_session is accepted by /api/me (no validation). Fine for demo, must not ship as real auth.
recipes_data.py is ~26KB static data in a single module; consider splitting per pet if it keeps growing (currently acceptable, under 700 lines of logic).
Dashboard.jsx: api.get('/premium-products') and api.get('/stats') have no .catch() — an API failure produces an unhandled promise rejection and no error UI.
Login.jsx: 'Esqueci minha senha' and 'Criar conta' are dead href='#' links with no handler/feedback.

success_rate.frontend: 92% (all requested flows pass; 1 UI overlap + 1 favorites/filter inconsistency)

seed_data_creation: None needed — static JSON data, no DB. Login user mariana@email.com used for session tests.
test_credentials: mariana@email.com / 123456 (simulated login, any filled values accepted) — from /app/memory/test_credentials.md
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (30 tests, run with `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py`); it asserts 36 recipes (32 gato / 4 cachorro), difficulty split facil=20 total across all pets, petisco=16, and validates every recipe detail payload. Frontend flows fully covered via data-testids; note stats need ~2s wait after login before asserting values (initially render 0). Favorites live in the non-httponly cookie pet_favoritos, so they persist across reloads in the same browser context. Open items: modal favorite/close button overlap and favorites-view being intersected with active filters.
rca_of_the_issue: Overlap: RecipeModal places its own favorite button at absolute top-4 right-4, the exact slot where shadcn/Radix DialogContent injects its close button; Radix appends the close after children so the X paints over the heart. Favorites view: Dashboard computes `visible = showFavsOnly ? recipes.filter(r => favorites.includes(r.id)) : recipes`, where `recipes` is already the server-filtered subset for the active pet filter (default 'gato'), so favorites from other pets are dropped from the list while still counted in the header.
